$comment: Scheduled posting (flag post-schedule; D310, D314, D375). Every automatic YouTube upload goes up with status.publishAt (YouTube Studio shows it as Scheduled; it goes public at that time); an automatic upload without a time never happens (it waits). Slot rule (D375, placement fill-gaps): the earliest time, on the alignMinutes grid (60 = whole hours, UTC), that is at least now + minLeadHours + marginMinutes and at least intervalHours away from EVERY taken time: each scheduled post on the channel, each channel video published recently, every time already in the upload queue (uploaded, open session, failed, queued) and every slot given out earlier in the same pass. So new posts fill the gaps around the existing schedule and no two posts are less than intervalHours apart. placement after-last keeps the old D310 rule (start after the latest taken time + intervalHours). A D314 retry (a queued clip whose time came less than minLeadHours away before its upload session started) gets a new slot by the same rule; other queued clips keep theirs. A slot more than maxAheadDays ahead is not given out: the clip waits. Before an upload session starts or resumes, the slot must still be at least minLeadHours ahead; before every chunk, at least marginMinutes ahead. Every chunk request is aborted chunkDeadlineSeconds before the slot, and the final chunk only starts when its estimated transfer time fits (slowest chunk measured in this upload, else fallbackKbps; chunkDeadlineSeconds must be less than marginMinutes x 60). Channel read: the uploads list newest first, pageSize per page, at most maxPages pages; the read stops (complete) at the first page whose items were all added more than lookbackDays ago. If maxPages is reached first, nothing is scheduled (fail closed). Risk of the lookback: a video uploaded more than lookbackDays ago but scheduled to go public in the future is not seen (Ujwalam's own uploads are still known from its queue). The user's own settings (Settings > Posting & growth > Auto-post) are saved in <data dir>/posting/schedule.json and replace intervalHours, maxAheadDays and placement (that file also holds quotaUnitsPerDay, see data/posting/quota.json); they apply on the next pass, no restart. Read by services/posting/schedule.mjs; never hardcoded. YouTube Data API quota: 1 unit per channels.list, playlistItems.list and videos.list call (1 + up to 2 per page).
source: intervalHours 1: user 2026-11-13, later the same day ('build a posting schedule every one hour for the next 2 months'; first that day 6 h 'for the time being', before that 6 h on 2026-11-09). placement fill-gaps: user request 2026-11-13 ('schedule the posts according to work around the existing schedule. don't double post at the same time'). maxAheadDays 60: user 2026-11-13 ('for the next 2 months'); the user's own setting may go up to 730 days (user 2026-11-09, D314, 'can schedule upto 2 years ahead'). alignMinutes 60, lookbackDays 120, maxPages 40: agent 2026-11-13 (D375), not a user instruction: whole hours match the channel's own schedule; 120 days covers the furthest hand-scheduled post seen on the channel (23 days ahead on 2026-11-13) five times over, and the 2-month plan twice; 40 pages = 2000 uploads at most 81 quota units per read. minLeadHours, marginMinutes, chunkDeadlineSeconds (coordinator review 2026-11-09: about 2 min), fallbackKbps, pageSize: agent default 2026-11-09, not a user instruction; tune here. minGapMinutes (D314 gap, 2026-11-09) retired 2026-11-13: every gap is intervalHours now.
